name: Strahovice (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly into a blue upper fly part and a yellow lower hoist part, with a disc counterchanged over the division.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 19 January 1995 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
